decisions.statement: This shell is shipped inside the native WebView as well as served to a browser.
A browser signs out by posting, because a cookie the server set is the server's to clear.
The native shell signs out in the WebView, because it serves no route to post to.
Signing out clears the session wherever the auth mode keeps the session.
Where a person lands after a session ends is decided by the auth provider alone.

definition: the frame every signed-in page of Alan's site is drawn inside
